purpose: Teach: マトリックス/パンダ/ウェールズ/マイホーム/ビーム/スピン/うなぎ/デイトレ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマトリックス映画好きでいらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad really does love those Matrix movies, doesn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Speaking to herself as much as to him. Warm recognition of something she's noticed about Ryosuke. Slight trailing warmth — not interrogative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと動物園でパンダ見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to the zoo with Dad and we saw pandas!
lines.style: Bright and direct, almost bursting to share. Quick pace. No hesitation — the excitement outweighs any self-consciousness. Opens with energy on the first word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、ウェールズ留学のお話してたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me about studying abroad in Wales.
lines.style: Conversational, passing along information she's absorbed. Matter-of-fact delivery. Not questioning — just setting context for why she's thinking of it now. Gentle, present voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、マイホームに住める日、楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mom, I can't wait until the day we have our own house.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Soft certainty underneath — this is something he's thought about. Not dreamy, but genuine longing. Simple, direct, unhurried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがレーザービームのおもちゃ持ってるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has one of those laser-beam toys, you know.
lines.style: Light, slightly amused observation. As if remembering something she'd almost forgotten. Warm tone — she's noting it like sharing a small secret with him. Ends with gentle ease.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、コマのスピンを練習してるよ
lines.en: Mom, I've been practicing how to spin my top really fast.
lines.style: Proud but not boastful. Owns the accomplishment quietly. Steady pace. The 'really fast' carries just a hint of satisfaction — he knows he's getting better.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがうなぎを召し上がるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather, he does love his eel.
lines.style: Observational, slightly wry. A small smile underneath — noticing a family trait. Unhurried, gentle. The affection sits in the space between the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがデイトレのお話してたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was telling me about day trading.
lines.style: Quieter than the excited moments. Thoughtful, absorbing information. The pace slows slightly — he's processing something new. No enthusiasm, but genuine curiosity underneath.
